source_notes: QC's pxlimited.com URL is confirmed dead (HTTP 404). The Operator value itself (PX Group) was already updated by Natalia and is CORRECT -- confirmed with a genuinely independent, higher-quality pair: lngindustry.com trade press report (9 Oct 2025) and the official Government of Gibraltar communique (infogibraltar.com PDF, 8 Oct 2025, quoting Minister Gemma Arias-Vasquez and PX Group CEO Geoff Holmes on the Molgas-to-PX Group operator transition -- extracted via direct pdftotext since WebFetch's own PDF summarizer failed on the binary). Both verified PASS via url_verifier.py.

QC's automated pass marked BOTH wikimapia.org and man-es.com as 'ok' -- both are false positives I caught on independent re-check, exactly the scenario the brief warned about ('don't inherit a QC pass'). man-es.com: url_verifier.py FAILED on token 'Gibraltar'; raw fetch showed the page title is now 'Discover stories' with no Gibraltar content, and curl -sIL confirmed a 301 redirect chain to https://www.everllence.com/discover-stories/ (a generic hub page -- MAN Energy Solutions rebranded to 'Everllence' and the specific article is gone; genuine content-drift link rot, not a bot-block). wikimapia.org: raw fetch returned only a 158-byte JS meta-refresh redirect stub (document.cookie set + client-side redirect, no server-rendered map content), and no Wayback snapshot exists to fall back on. Both dropped. The remaining google maps pin alone is judged sufficient for a coordinate citation, consistent with the georeference workflow's single-mapping-service convention. Location value (coordinates) itself unchanged.

man-es.com was this field's SOLE citation and is confirmed dead (see Location [ref] entry above for the corporate-rebrand-redirect evidence -- same URL, same dead verdict). Replaced with the official Government of Gibraltar press release, which explicitly names the Rock power station as the terminal's offtake and describes the LNG-to-power supply arrangement -- verified PASS via url_verifier.py on both 'LNG' and 'power'+'plant' tokens (the correct URL was initially mistyped in an early attempt, causing a false 404; corrected against the exact URL stored in citqc_Gibraltar.json's construction_date_ref row). PowerPlantsSupplied value ('Gibraltar's Rock power station') unchanged.
